coordinates.docling_adapter: Docling bottom-left boxes -> [left,H-top,right,H-bottom] with original page height; top-left boxes unchanged. Check page dimensions, crop/rotation and UserUnit explicitly; fail sample if ambiguous transformation.
coordinates.native: pdfplumber extraction bbox [x0, top, x1, bottom], PDF points, origin page top-left. Original page geometry retained in page_geometry.json. No normalized coordinates.
coordinates.review_raster: Verified pages only: rotation=0, UserUnit=1, media=crop=bbox=[0,0,W,H]; actual raster Wpx/W and Hpx/H independently, not assumed 1.5 after rounding.

gates.accounting: Include base-image pulls/layers + all Linux cp311 wheels, model/config and metadata under 2GiB new downloads and 4GiB installed/cache. Never reuse macOS wheel resolution. Linux closure/license review occurs only after actual architecture/runtime established. No image/model install if feasibility/control enforcement unproven.
gates.controls: Before Docling install: disposable model-free container reads actual cgroup memory.max <=4GiB, memory.swap.max=0, cpu.max <=4 cores; demonstrate child-inclusive memory enforcement, observed CPU quota, external timeout whole-tree/container termination and bounded disk/download accounting. Config flags alone are not proof.
gates.on_failure: Stop at first unmet prerequisite. C/D not_run, comparative metrics null, no model-memory/accuracy conclusions. Preserve freeze and independent review package.
gates.runtime: Already available local Docker/Podman Linux runtime only; no daemon start, runtime install, remote host, privilege elevation or settings changes. No GPU, host network, socket/secret mounts, privileged mode or network in inference. Prefer native arm64.

metrics.aggregation: Per-page, per-document and per-layout raw TP/FP/FN and counts. Per-document macro scores separate from micro. Failed/timed-out pages remain all-six-page denominator with full truth FN, no fabricated successful predictions; unsupported metrics null plus counts and reasons. Agent-only versus human references never pooled.
metrics.classification: Coarse mapped types on matched boxes plus unmatched boxes as FP/FN; heading and caption end-to-end P/R/F1, confusion matrix and false headings on math category. One ambiguous table-note type excluded ONLY from type denominator; localization kept.
metrics.order: Enumerated known ordered region pairs only. Match localization endpoints; unmatched endpoints count unscoreable failures in denominator. Strict DAG reachability in Structure0.2, Docling document item order where exposed; classify correct/inversion/abstention/unscoreable. An ambiguous or cyclic relation never earns correct. Ambiguity groups not expanded into asserted orders.
metrics.paragraph: Each frozen decision references two original source-character sets inside visual line strips. Assign each strip to unique predicted text region covering >=50% of its source-character centers; ties ambiguous. Same region means join, distinct means break. Unmapped/ambiguous counts unscoreable in full denominator. Report join/break confusion, accuracy and coverage.
metrics.region_localization: One-to-one greedy matching at IoU >= 0.5, ignore type; sort descending IoU then frozen truth ID then stable prediction ID. Prediction eligible when center lies in any page window, counted once. All truth regions in windows. Duplicates/unmatched predictions FP; unmatched truth FN. Panel granularity fixed; no enclosing-figure substitution.
metrics.resources: Per page external wall timeout <=120s, cgroup memory.peak incl children, memory.events/OOM, swap and cpu.stat; CPU quota and effective native pools <=4. Cold initialization and warm inference separately; installed logical/uncompressed, physical allocated and layer/cache peaks separate from compressed downloads. Output bytes and source adapter time separately.
metrics.source_grounding: For each prediction retain original geometry/label, map original character centers inside bbox to original IDs, preserve Unicode/order. Unique ownership valid; overlaps many-to-many/ambiguous, missing/unmapped/contradictory explicit. Figure with no text legitimately empty, not fabricated. Compare content only separately; no normalization or semantic/Unicode repair. Native model text is never authoritative.

type_mapping.reference_scoring: reference and text are one coarse text class for classification; reference category still reported separately
type_mapping.unknown_policy: Unknown labels retained as unknown, never discarded or silently reclassified. Figures cannot be inferred from text on the baseline.
